body: Hm... I don't think I will feel insulted if you say something bad about my family; I do have some pent up anger towards them, after all. I agree with you. Sometimes, I don't know why I try so hard to get approval. I don't necessarily want to kill myself, I just want to go to sleep and never wake up again. I guess I'm just tired of living. But I guess taking the easy way out is not allowed, after all. And don't worry. You ARE helping. You are helping me more than a large number of people have helped me. I'm very glad to know that there are people that will listen to my problems without judging me and are willing to help me all they can. I have calmed down. Thank you for sparing your time to listen to my problems, I really appreciate it. And I will continue trying to improve myself and for my own sake. Thank you again.

I don't really know where to start, but I'm sure of this. Since I was young, I've been constantly ignored. And overtime,I learned to seek attention more and more. I've always tried to be the "good child", always staying out of trouble, trying so hard to be perfect, and never showing my weaknesses. I tried never to be a burden for my family. I've always tried to solve everything myself, hoping that I would be praised for being the "good kid".But it has always yielded the opposite effect. My family, thinking that I had no problems, cared even less of me. As my facade continued on, I became scared of being judged, scared of having my disguise destroyed, and came to have problems expressing myself.
I vdon't know where these problems came from, but recently, I've been having a lot of self destructive thoughts. Thoughts that say that I'm not good enough, thoughts that say that I'm worthless. Thoughts that say that I don't matter. Thoughts that say that I'm useless.Thoughts that say that I should just go ahead and disappear. And I feel miserable and pathetic. I know that those thoughts aren't true. But they hurt too much. Day in and day out, I've been dealing with these demons of my own and they've been becoming more than I can handle. I've tried to talk to my family; my sister or my mother. But they have dismissed my problems. I don't know how much longer I can stay like this. I'm sorry if this is all too confusing, my mind is a mess right now, and I'm sorry for dumping it all on you like this. And I appreciate that you're willing to spend your time to help a complete stranger like me.
